title: Rice, white, with carrots, no added fat

content.title: About
content.content: White rice with carrots and no added fat is a ready‑to‑eat product consisting of boiled white rice and finely diced carrots. It is prepared without oil or other fats, making it low‑calorie and suitable for diet menus.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: White rice is one of the most consumed grain foods worldwide.
Carrots are rich in beta‑carotene, which the body converts to vitamin A.
The absence of added fats reduces the dish’s calorie count to about 120 kcal per 100 g.
Rice with carrots is traditionally prepared in Asian cuisines as a side dish or soup base.
When stored properly, rice retains its flavor and quality for up to a year.

items.title: Source of carbohydrates
items.content: White rice provides a quick source of energy through easily digestible carbs.

items.title: Beta‑carotene from carrots
items.content: Beta‑carotene supports vision, immunity, and skin health.

items.title: Low fat content
items.content: No added fats make the dish suitable for weight management and cholesterol control.

items.title: Contains vitamin B6
items.content: Vitamin B6 is involved in protein metabolism and neurotransmitter synthesis.

items.title: Digestive support
items.content: Carrot fiber promotes regular bowel movements.

items.title: High glycemic index
items.content: White rice can raise blood sugar quickly, so people with diabetes should monitor portion sizes.

items.title: Low fiber compared to whole grains
items.content: White rice provides less dietary fiber than whole‑grain varieties.

items.title: Carrot allergy
items.content: A small number of individuals may experience an allergic reaction to carrots.

items.title: Arsenic contamination
items.content: In some regions rice may contain elevated arsenic levels; choose reputable suppliers.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve as a side dish with meat or fish, add to salads, soups, or use as a quick meal base. Optional seasonings, herbs, or low‑sodium soy sauce can be added without extra oil.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep in an airtight container in the refrigerator for 3‑4 days. For longer storage, freeze in portion‑size bags for up to 2 months. Reheat to at least 75 °C before consumption.
